node.title: Need Net::FTP delete help
node.author: Todd Chester
node.doctext:
Dear Perl Monks,

Gee Wiz (not my "exact" word[s]), a lot of stuff in Net::FTP does not work correctly. Mumble, mumble.

I can not delete
$ftp->delete (name)

or rename
$ftp->rename ( oldname, newname )

a file if the name of the file starts with a dot. For example
.metadata

AAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!

How in the world do I work around this one?

Many thanks,
-T
